prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic candid kitchen lifestyle photo using one required approved-adult identity reference.
prompt.main_subject: The same original approved adult man from the attached reference leans over a stovetop, focused on cooking nachos and grating cheese over a large pan. Preserve his face, facial structure, skin texture, and identity. The observed outfit is a dark sleeveless tank top with dark casual pants.

prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm under-cabinet lighting in an evening kitchen, soft directional highlights, natural shadows on the arms and countertop, cozy intimate candid mood with realistic food texture.
prompt.technical_specs: Ultra-photorealistic handheld phone look, portrait 4:5, approximately 28mm lens perspective, crisp but natural focus, subtle analog grain, visible pores and real-world kitchen imperfections, no text or watermark.

Preserve his face, facial structure, skin texture, and identity. He wears the observed dark sleeveless tank top and dark casual pants. White square-tile backsplash, black induction cooktop, warm under-cabinet lights, mortar and pestle, tray, paper towel, grater, cheese block, crispy chips, and visible cheese strands create a realistic evening cooking scene. Handheld phone perspective around 28mm, warm natural highlights, subtle analog grain, crisp but candid texture.
